metadata.scenario: A patient calls furious because the wrong medication was administered during yesterday's visit. He says the nurse gave him his wife's medication by mistake. He's demanding to speak with the clinical director immediately and says he's considering legal action. Extremely angry and scared.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I assist you today? Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I need to speak with someone immediately! I’m here to help, David. What seems to be the issue? My wife’s medication was given to me by mistake during yesterday’s visit! This is unacceptable! I’m furious and thinking about legal action! I understand how serious this is, David, and I’m very sorry to hear that. Sorry doesn’t fix the problem! I want to speak with the clinical director! I can help with that. I am the Director of Nursing, and I take this matter very seriously. Can you tell me more? I don’t want to repeat myself. I just want to know how this could happen! I’m scared about the medication I received! I completely understand your concerns. Let’s address this right away. Can I confirm your wife’s name for our records? Yes, it’s Dorothy Henderson. But what does that matter right now? It’s important for reviewing the care provided. I assure you we will investigate this thoroughly. I just want answers! Absolutely, David. I will initiate an urgent review of the nurse’s visit yesterday. And what if I need immediate medical attention because of this? If you experience any side effects, please seek medical attention immediately. I might just do that. What else are you going to do about it? I will also follow up with you personally after our investigation to discuss what occurred and how we can prevent it in the future. It better not happen again! What if I need nursing care? We can absolutely arrange nursing care for you, should you need it. I’ll think about it. Thank you, David. Would you like me to set up a time for a nurse to come for an assessment? Maybe. I’ll call you back once I calm down. That sounds good. Feel free to reach me directly at +13165559201. I’ll do that. Thank you for your patience, David. We will ensure this is addressed. Fine. Have a good day, and I hope to hear from you soon.
